5 /-! The completed universal-source star development yields an unfolding
6 of the original whole faces, using the unchanged public definition. -/

8 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
9 
10 open Set
11 
12 /-- The universal-source star gives an edge unfolding in the remaining small-face family. -/
13 theorem universal_star_has_edge_unfolding {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (six : P.vertices.card = 6)
14     (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
15       (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
16     (source : P.Vertex) (universal : ∀ v : P.Vertex, v ≠ source → P.edgeGraph.Adj source v) :
17     P.HasEdgeUnfolding := by
18   let a : frontier P.body := ⟨source, P.vertex_mem_frontier source.property⟩
19   have cofacial := universal_source_cofacial a source rfl universal
20   obtain ⟨develop, embedding, _, _, _, locally_isometric⟩ :=
21     universal_star_embedding six small_faces a source rfl universal
22   exact edge_unfolding_of_star_development develop embedding.injective locally_isometric
23     (small_cofacial_uncut_surface_pathConnected (show P.vertices.card ≤ 6 by omega)
24       small_faces a cofacial).isConnected.isPreconnected
25     (P.universal_star_face_interiors_uncut a source rfl universal)
26 
27 /-- With at most six vertices, a universal vertex always gives an edge unfolding.
28 The earlier reduction handles smaller solids and faces with more than four vertices. -/
29 theorem hasEdgeUnfolding_of_universal_vertex {P : ConvexPolyhedron}
30     (at_most_six : P.vertices.card ≤ 6) (source : P.Vertex)
31     (universal : ∀ v : P.Vertex, v ≠ source → P.edgeGraph.Adj source v) :
32     P.HasEdgeUnfolding := by
33   rcases unfolding_or_remaining_cases P at_most_six with unfolded | ⟨six, small_faces⟩
34   · exact unfolded
35   · exact universal_star_has_edge_unfolding six small_faces source universal
36 
37 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
